suite.identity: Complete JIT tiers, native calls and native class modes with contemporaneous AOT/C++ references

comparison.reason: These runs use the same binary with different complete suite selections (142 AOT cases and 362 AOT/JIT cases). They are not optimization before/after evidence.
comparison.previous_summary_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False; sort_keys=True; separators=(',', ':'); no trailing newline

benchmark_context.algorithms_cpp: GN Release flags; FP contraction disabled; stable_sort
benchmark_context.aot_codegen: LLVM O3; generic CPU; PIC; checked arithmetic; explicit roots
benchmark_context.escape_allocation_sample: separate warmed Isolate; automatic GC disabled; one invocation
benchmark_context.jit_baseline: LLVM O3; host CPU; current dispatch; precise roots; safepoints
benchmark_context.jit_optimized: LLVM O3; host CPU; typed slots; SCC direct calls/inlining; body dependencies; selective recovery

validation.native_call_comparison: native_call_report passed; every script sample returned to baseline heap state

limitations: This run measures existing implementations and does not optimize JIT.
Compilation, input preparation and warm-up are excluded from steady timing.
Macro JIT is reloadable and retains dispatch, safepoints, external fields and recovery; AOT uses its closed contract.
Each selected macro source/tier is compiled once before sampling; preparation counters are single setup observations.
Native class modes distinguish closed baseline/optimized from reloadable baseline/optimized.
All samples and CVs are retained; RSS includes LLVM and every prepared image in the process.
